webhooks.detail: Notifications API (POST /crm/v8/actions/watch): subscribe to module events (create/edit/delete/all) with notify_url, channel expiry, optional field conditions. Also workflow-rule webhook actions.

evidence.quote: To enable instant notifications of actions performed on a module.

sandbox.detail: Free full-featured Developer Edition account; CRM sandbox also exists (isolated from production, in paid editions).

evidence.quote: Zoho CRM's free developer edition is a fully-featured application environment

rate_limits.summary: Credit-based, 24h rolling: Free 5,000/day; Professional 50k+500/user; Enterprise 50k+1000/user. Concurrency 5-25 per org by edition; sub-concurrency 10 for heavy calls.

evidence.quote: Each API call made will result in a reduction of 1 credit.
